statement.zh: **标准**：联邦信息与组织的信息安全持续监视（SP 800-137）（Information Security Continuous Monitoring (ISCM) for Federal Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-137)）。主题定义在文首的执行摘要：「Information security continuous monitoring (ISCM) is defined as maintaining ongoing awareness of information security, vulnerabilities, and threats to support organizational risk management decisions.」§1.3 给出本文件的动作：「The purpose of this guideline is to assist organizations in the development of an ISCM strategy and the implementation of an ISCM program that provides awareness of threats and vulnerabilities, visibility into organizational assets, and the effectiveness of deployed security controls.
statement.en: **Standard**: Information Security Continuous Monitoring (ISCM) for Federal Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-137) (联邦信息与组织的信息安全持续监视（SP 800-137）).The subject definition sits in the Executive Summary at the front: "Information security continuous monitoring (ISCM) is defined as maintaining ongoing awareness of information security, vulnerabilities, and threats to support organizational risk management decisions." Section 1.

statement.zh: 理由先给法定下限再给运行理由。§1.1 交代 2002 年法的要求：「The Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) of 2002 further emphasized the importance of continuously monitoring information system security by requiring agencies to conduct assessments of security controls at a frequency appropriate to risk, but no less than annually.」再记当年OMB备忘的口径：「The memorandum provides instructions for annual FISMA reporting and emphasizes monitoring the security state of information systems on an ongoing basis with a frequency sufficient to make ongoing, risk-based decisions.
statement.en: The argument gives the statutory floor first and then the operational reason.Section 1.1 records what the 2002 statute required: "The Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) of 2002 further emphasized the importance of continuously monitoring information system security by requiring agencies to conduct assessments of security controls at a frequency appropriate to risk, but no less than annually." It then records the reporting posture of the year: "The memorandum provides instructions for annual FISMA reporting and emphasizes monitoring the security state of information systems on an ongoing basis with a frequency sufficient to make ongoing, risk-based decisions.

statement.zh: 谁做什么由 §2.4 的角色条目与第三层的判定句承担，措辞是陈述句而非 shall。§2.4 写首席信息官：「The CIO ensures that an effective ISCM program is established and implemented for the organization」，写授权官：「reviews security status reports and critical security documents and determines if the risk to the organization from operation of the information system remains acceptable.」§3.1 把频率判定落到系统所有者：「System owners determine assessment frequencies of security controls based on drivers from all three tiers.」并把证据交付写成组织政策决定的下限：「Assessment evidence obtained from ISCM is, at a minimum, provided to AOs as often as required by organizational policy.
statement.en: Who acts is carried by the role entries of §2.4 and the decision sentences at the system tier, stated as plain present tense rather than shall.Section 2.4 says of the chief information officer "The CIO ensures that an effective ISCM program is established and implemented for the organization" and of the authorizing official "reviews security status reports and critical security documents and determines if the risk to the organization from operation of the information system remains acceptable." Section 3.1 puts frequency decisions on the system owner: "System owners determine assessment frequencies of security controls based on drivers from all three tiers.

statement.zh: 四处限度层级不同。§3.1 自陈非规定性：「The guidelines below, though not prescriptive, helps to ensure an organization-wide approach to ISCM that best promotes standardized methodologies and consistent practices」。第一章开篇承认自动化的边界：该句印在 CHAPTER ONE 与 INTRODUCTION 两个标题之后、1.1 BACKGROUND 之前的正文段内（留存件在这一页仍印着 PAGE 1 的页面板）：「While this document encourages the use of automation, it is recognized that many aspects of ISCM programs are not easily automated.
statement.en: The four limits work at different levels.Section 3.1 states its own non-prescriptiveness: "The guidelines below, though not prescriptive, helps to ensure an organization-wide approach to ISCM that best promotes standardized methodologies and consistent practices".

statement.zh: 扉页编号行「NIST Special Publication 800-137」，标题行给出 ISCM 缩写与联邦限定，作者行按序列出八人「Kelley Dempsey Nirali Shah Chawla Arnold Johnson Ronald Johnston Alicia Clay Jones Angela Orebaugh Matthew Scholl Kevin Stine」，日期行在扉页上以大写排印为 SEPTEMBER 2011，其下为部与局的署名列「Patrick D.Gallagher, Under Secretary for Standards and Technology and Director」。Authority 页给出依据与规模：「This publication has been developed by NIST to further its statutory responsibilities under the Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA), Public Law (P.L.) 107-347.」与分行印出的「NIST Special Publication 800-137, 80 pages」，其下一行单独印出括注日期 (September 2011)——本副本里页数与日期是两行，并非连排一行。
statement.en: The title block carries "NIST Special Publication 800-137", a part title that spells out ISCM and confines it to federal systems, and the author line naming eight people in order, "Kelley Dempsey Nirali Shah Chawla Arnold Johnson Ronald Johnston Alicia Clay Jones Angela Orebaugh Matthew Scholl Kevin Stine", with the date line set in capitals on the title block and the signing officials below it, of whom "Patrick D.Gallagher, Under Secretary for Standards and Technology and Director".
